title: Beautiful
text: Beautiful, it is a miniature jewel of great beauty; it had struck me since I saw it in a movie and I really wanted to see it in person, truly beautiful because it is rich in colors, decorations, and details, and despite not being very large, it is impressive. One of the most beautiful places in Seville
author: 172Traveller

title: A must do tour in Seville.
text: Carmen was absolutely amazing. We learnt so much and the palaces were so interesting. I highly recommend this as a tour to do n Seville.
author: Lisa W

title: It is fun and good
text:
The horse carriage private tour was absolutely delightful 
You see teh city’s places well and the weather was too good so it was very comfortable
author: Amidave

title: Take a guided ride! You won't regret it.
text: This is a MUST! We did not just get on a horse and carriage we had Alba an informative, cultured, and fun tour guide with us! She truly made our ride a wonderful experience. As we looked around to other carriages they seemed to marvel at the beautiful architecture but had no clue about they symbolism. It's worth the time and money!
author: Angelica_M

title: Great introduction to Saville.
text: A great introduction to Seville for the children—-what a wonderful way to see the sights,from an open topped,horse drawn carriage?
author: David_F

title: Relaxing relaxing
text:
Absolutely fabulous, saw many landmarks that we missed on our walk.
A lovely leisurely way to see the sights.
Carriage was clean and well maintained. Guide spoke english and was informative.
Felt safe at all times in sorts of traffic conditions
author: 830E

title: Very nice introduction to Seville
text: Alba was a wonderful guide and orovided lots of information about the city and its history. The tour took in many of the city highlights
author: Brian_B

title: Great tour of the city - stylish and fun!
text: An excellent tour of the city. Very informative . Lovely to ride in the carriage. Very stylish. We had a very good guide.
author: ME_J

title: Best tour in Sevilla
text: We loved every minute of this tour. From the horse and carriage to the knowledgeable, fun, and friendly tour guide. She was so wonderful we had to book another tour with her the next day!
author: Robin_F
